positive_trails.artifact: Opus deepthink audit — magic-chat.html + chat.js + index.js
positive_trails.success: Full audit in one pass: found zero @media, zero -webkit-backdrop-filter, zero reduced-motion in magic-chat.html. Found raw Deepgram key exposure (BB-43). Found infinite reconnect loop (B2). Found visibilitychange listener leak (B5). All critical risks identified before execution.
positive_trails.reuse: Use Opus audit-first on UI files before any facelift dispatch. It finds security/architecture risks that Sonnet misses inline.

positive_trails.success: Single --mode-color / --mode-glow / --mode-bg vars on body[data-mode] cascade to header, mic, avatar, future elements. Mode-tinted room achieved with minimal CSS surface. No JS style injection needed for color.
positive_trails.reuse: Use body[data-mode] pattern for any multi-mode UI. Declare vars on :root as default (free), override on body[data-mode=study/phonics].

positive_trails.success: 2→4→8→16→30s cap, max 5, reset on SettingsApplied. Eliminates infinite KV-read storm on Deepgram outage at scale.
positive_trails.reuse: This pattern (agentReconnectCount, agentReconnectTimer, reset on clean connect) is canonical for any WebSocket with CF Worker backend.

negative_trails.artifact: PA T1 Kilo — C3 server hardening dispatch
negative_trails.failure: 30s timeout on code generation task. Fourth occurrence: run054/055/057/058. Pattern: any PA T1 task involving multi-step code changes to a large file (index.js = 3231+ lines).
negative_trails.root_cause: Kilo free auto 30s wall. Complex/large-file code generation exceeds ceiling. Task description + context bundle = too much token work.

negative_trails.artifact: PA T10 — C3 stub response (no file access)
negative_trails.failure: T10 returned 2-line stub: 'think: { provider: { type: open_ai, model: gpt-4o-mini }…'. No actual patch output.
negative_trails.root_cause: PA T10 has no file system access. Task referenced index.js sections by description only, not by passing the actual code block. Fix: always pass old_string/new_string content in the task, not path+description.

negative_trails.failure: SHA256 of empty string (e3b0c44...) because `$input` is a reserved PowerShell automatic variable (pipeline accumulator). Used as function param = always receives empty pipeline.
negative_trails.root_cause: PowerShell reserved variables: $input, $args, $PSBoundParameters, $_. Never use these as function parameter names. Use $str, $data, $content instead.

negative_trails.failure: InvalidOperation: A hash table can only be added to another hash table. Fired when appending [PSCustomObject] to hashtable array values returned by ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable.
negative_trails.root_cause: ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable stores inner arrays as typed System.Object[]. Appending PSCustomObject triggers type conflict. Fix: use @{} hashtable literals consistently on both sides of the append. Third occurrence: run057 C2, run058 C4.
